Name: BigDumbYak's Artisan Collector - Custom Machine
Author: BigDumbYak
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Artisan Collector[/b][/size]
[i]Automatically collect finished products from your artisan machines[/i][/center]
[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]
Tired of running around your massive shed checking every keg, preserves jar, and cheese press? The Artisan Collector is here to help! This handy machine automatically collects finished products from nearby artisan machines, saving you time and letting you focus on what matters most - expanding your farming empire.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[b]🔧 Automatic Collection[/b]
The Artisan Collector scans a configurable radius around itself and automatically picks up finished products from:
• Kegs
• Preserves Jars
• Cheese Presses
• Looms
• Oil Makers
• Mayonnaise Machines
• Crystalariums (optional, can be toggled in config)

[b]Built-in Storage[/b]
All collected items are stored in the machine's internal chest. Access it anytime by clicking on the machine - just like a regular chest!

[b]Indoor Placement Only[/b]
The Artisan Collector can only be placed indoors (barns, sheds, cabins, etc.). This prevents save corruption issues and keeps your farm looking tidy!

[b]Smart Detection[/b]
Only collects from machines that are completely finished - no interrupting your production mid-process.

[b]Fully Configurable[/b]
Customize every aspect via Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCU):
• Collection radius (default: 10 tiles)
• Update frequency (how often it checks for items)
• Collection sound effects (on/off)
• Visual collection animations (on/off)
• Crystalarium collection (on/off)
• Immediate unlock or quest-based unlock

[size=5][b]How to Unlock[/b][/size]
[b]Default Method:[/b]
Reach Farming Level 10, then wait 5 in-game days. Marnie will visit your farm with a special cutscene and gift you your first Artisan Collector!

[b]Instant Unlock:[/b]
Set [font=Courier New]UnlockImmediately = true[/font] in the config file to skip the waiting period. Just make the change, then when you wake up the next day the Artisan Collector will be unlocked.

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
2. Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
3. Run the game using SMAPI
4. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to customize settings in-game

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] in the mod folder, or use Generic Mod Config Menu:
[code]
{
  "CollectionRadius": 10,              // How far it scans (in tiles)
  "UpdateInterval": 60,                // Check frequency (60 = 1 second)
  "CollectFromCrystalariums": true,    // Include Crystalariums
  "PlayCollectionSound": true,         // Sound effect on collection
  "ShowCollectionAnimation": false,    // Visual sparkle effect
  "UnlockImmediately": false          // Skip the unlock quest
}
[/code]
[size=5][b]Tips & Tricks[/b][/size]
• Place your Artisan Collector in the center of your machine setup for maximum coverage
• The default 10-tile radius covers a large area - a single collector can service many machines
• Use multiple collectors or adjust the radius in large sheds to ensure complete coverage
• The machine shows a visual change when it contains items
• Access the storage at any time by clicking on the machine

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
✅ Works with all artisan machine mods (as long as they use standard machine names/IDs)
✅ Multiplayer compatible
✅ Safe to add to existing saves
✅ No conflicts with other automation mods

[size=5][b]FAQ[/b][/size]
[b]Q: Can I place this outside?[/b]
A: No, the Artisan Collector only works indoors to prevent save issues.
[b]Q: Does it work with modded machines?[/b]
A: It works with most modded machines that follow standard naming conventions. Some custom machines may not be detected.
[b]Q: Can I have multiple collectors?[/b]
A: Yes! Place as many as you need.
[b]Q: Does it consume power or resources?[/b]
A: No, it runs automatically with no maintenance required.

[size=5][b]Known Issues[/b][/size]
None currently! Please report any bugs in the Posts section.
